system.name: BGL
system.one_liner: a GPU-efficient GNN training system that optimizes graph data I/O and preprocessing

components.name: Distributed Graph Data Files
components.role: input graph data stored in a distributed storage system (e.g. HDFS)

components.name: Graph Partition Module
components.role: loads the graph data and shards the whole graph into partitions, a one-time cost reusable across training jobs

components.name: Graph Store Server
components.role: holds a graph partition in memory, ready for subgraph sampling

components.name: Sampler
components.role: samples subgraphs from the graph store, including cross-partition sampling

components.name: Worker Machine
components.role: hosts the CPU and GPUs that run GNN training on sampled subgraphs

components.name: Feature Cache Engine
components.role: caches node features on CPU and GPU to reduce remote feature retrieval

components.name: Worker
components.role: GPU process that trains on sampled subgraphs

content.key_idea: BGL partitions the graph once and serves it from replicated graph store servers with local and cross-partition subgraph sampling, feeding sampled subgraphs to worker machines whose multi-GPU plus CPU feature cache engine minimizes redundant remote feature fetches during GNN training.
content.reading_order: top-down: distributed graph data files feed the Graph Partition Module, which distributes partitions to two Graph Store Servers (with samplers and cross-partition links), which in turn feed two symmetric Worker Machines below, each containing a CPU-based Feature Cache Engine and multiple GPU workers linked by NVLink.

evidence: The overall architecture of BGL is shown in Figure 4
The graph par- tition module loads the graph data stored in the distributed storage system (e.g., HDFS), and shards the whole graph into several partitions
each partition is loaded into a graph store server's memory, ready for subgraph sampling

summary: This figure shows BGL's overall architecture in four layers. At the top, Distributed Graph Data Files feed the Graph Partition Module, which shards the graph once and distributes partitions to two symmetric Graph Store Servers below, each holding a Graph Store and multiple Samplers that also communicate cross-partition with the other server. The graph store servers feed sampled subgraphs and remote features down to two symmetric Worker Machines, each containing a CPU-side Feature Cache Engine and multiple GPU Workers linked by NVLink, with parameter synchronization occurring between the two worker machines. The mirrored, layered layout emphasizes BGL's replicated, distributed design for scaling graph storage, sampling, and GPU-efficient training together.
summary_zh: 该图展示BGL整体架构：分布式图数据经图分区模块分片后送至两台对称的图存储服务器（含采样器与跨分区通信），再向下送入两台工作机，每台工作机含CPU特征缓存引擎与通过NVLink互联的多GPU工作进程。
